_about: The one place the approved voice settings live. Source of truth for the descriptions is bible/characters.md; voice.py refuses to run if they differ.

treatment.pa_room: Prof H's lecture-hall mic lines add bass=g=9:f=110 and a hall echo (the whisper made to boom by the room)

characters.nio: A 21-year-old Black American guy, light-skinned, lower-mid pitch, warm and a little husky, quick and animated like the lead of a cartoon comedy; confident, cocky, playful; big swings between deadpan and excited; casual Gen Z delivery.
characters.maya: A young woman around 20, bright, sweet and earnest voice, soft and clear, slightly higher pitch, gentle and kind, a little breathless when excited; sincere and literal, like the kind sidekick in a cartoon.
characters.profh: A huge, gentle professor around sixty, hushed airy voice with a soft rasp, medium-low pitch, earnest and a little nervous, always talking like he is in a library.
characters.theo: A 21-year-old guy, clear mid pitch, quick and confident, a sports commentator's certainty in a quiet voice, slightly nasal, playful.
characters.darnell: A gentle man in his thirties, warm mid voice, dreamy and peaceful, speaks slowly and friendly, like a monk who likes video games.
characters.cleaner: A brisk woman in her fifties, bright clear voice, quick and casual, a little amused, has seen it all.

refused_characters.friend: The best friend has no approved voice (bible/characters.md).
